propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking change (deprecated v0.11.0, removed 2026-08-12), mapped to review_plan() and review_code().

Four CI lanes in the Live External Integration workflow fail with AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket' because two external test modules were not retargeted during the removal epic.

External test modules test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py call the removed review_ticket API but are excluded from the standard Verified gate, so the regression was invisible until live workflow_dispatch execution.

review_ticket() and review_plan() have incompatible signatures and return types (review_plan returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT with no top-level findings, failing existing test assertions for REVIEW_RESULT).
Both external modules must be retargeted to review_code() (surviving op returning REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings keys matching test assertions).
